articles.summary: Create and edit interactive 3D scenes right inside ChatGPT and Codex. The Spline plugin is available now in OpenAI's plugin directory.
articles.title: Introducing Spline for ChatGPT

articles.summary: Spline's MCP server now runs in the cloud: ask ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for a 3D scene and it's built in a real Spline file without the editor open, ready for you to open and keep editing. This update also brings PBR materials, booleans and timeline animations to the native iOS and Android exports, camera and light keyframes, smoother large files in Hana, and a long list of interaction fixes.
articles.title: Remote MCP, native PBR and more

articles.summary: Comments in the 3D editor have been rebuilt: a comments panel, real resolve, unread markers and previews on the canvas. Spline's AI agent can now work from comments too. Ask AI on a thread and it makes the change, looks from the commenter's view and replies with what it did.
articles.title: Improved 3D editor comments, now with AI
